description: A leaderboard score entry stored in a player's repository.

main.description: Published in the player's PDS when recording a run for a `games.opengaming.leaderboard.definition`. Supports single-integer `score`, local multi-component values (`#points`, `#percentage`, `#time`, `#enum`, `#text`), sub-board `dimensions` and daily/custom `seed`, co-op `participants` + `runId`, open-union genre `details`, chart/build `version` hashes, deterministic `replay` blobs, and optional multi-issuer inline `signatures`.

leaderboard.description: AT-URI of the `games.opengaming.leaderboard.definition` record in the game publisher's repository.

definitionCid.description: Optional CID snapshot of the `leaderboard.definition` record when the score was set.

game.description: Optional AT-URI of the game definition (`games.atmosphere.define`).

player.description: DID of the player who achieved this score (must match the repository DID housing this record).

score.description: Headline integer score value (e.g. points, milliseconds, Elo rating, or `defaultComponent` value). Recommended on all records so generic gamercards can render rankings without custom component logic; optional when `components` is provided.

displayScore.description: Optional pre-formatted fallback display string (e.g. `42 pts`, `1:06.03`, `99.42% · FC`) for lightweight feed viewers.

components.description: Optional dictionary map of local typed component values (`#points`, `#percentage`, `#time`, `#enum`, `#text`) keyed by the component keys declared in `leaderboard.definition#components`.

dimensions.description: Optional dictionary map of sub-board category values (e.g. `{ "mode": "4k", "inputMethod": "keyboard", "character": "luigi" }`) matching `leaderboard.definition#dimensions`.

seed.description: Optional daily puzzle ID, procedural world seed, or challenge token (e.g. `2026-11-08` or `BALATRO-8K2F9`).

participants.description: Optional roster of co-op teammates, duo partners, or squad members who achieved this score together.

runId.description: Optional shared deterministic session/clear ID across co-op teammates' PDS score records so AppViews deduplicate a team run into a single ranked row.

details.description: Optional open-union genre breakdown (e.g. `games.opengaming.defs#judgmentBreakdown` for rhythm games, or any custom `$type` lexicon object).

version.description: Optional hash or version tag of the chart, map, or game build this score was earned on (matched against `leaderboard.definition#rankedVersions`).

replay.description: Optional deterministic input log or ghost replay blob stored in the player's PDS, enabling asynchronous community Labeler or AppView verification even after official server End-of-Service (EoS).

tag.description: Optional short metadata tag attached to the run (e.g. `posts:30,likes:12`).

recordedAt.description: Timestamp when the score was achieved.

signatures.description: Optional inline CID-first cryptographic attestations (`games.opengaming.defs#inlineSignature`). Kept optional so games remain playable and PDS-writable after server EoS.

points.description: Integer points/count value matching a `leaderboard.definition#points` entry under the same map key.

percentage.description: Scaled fixed-point integer percentage value matching a `leaderboard.definition#percentage` entry under the same map key.

time.description: Integer time duration value matching a `leaderboard.definition#time` entry under the same map key.

enum.description: Option `id` matching a `leaderboard.definition#enum` entry under the same map key.

text.description: Display text value matching a `leaderboard.definition#text` entry under the same map key.

componentMap.description: Dictionary map of component key (`record-key` format, matching `leaderboard.definition#components`) to local typed component value (`#points`, `#percentage`, `#time`, `#enum`, `#text`). Forward-compatible with the proposed Lexicon `map` type without changing wire data or DAG-CBOR attestation CIDs.

$keyFormat.description: Placeholder schema hint for future Lexicon `map` key validation (never written in records).

$valueType.description: Placeholder schema hint for future Lexicon `map` value validation (never written in records).
